goal: Create `src/greet.js` with a `greet(name)` helper that returns exactly `Hello, <name>!`. Add focused tests in `test/greet.test.js` without modifying any other file.

alternatives.title: Named export
tradeoffs: Requires callers and tests to import the named symbol explicitly.
Fits projects that expose multiple helpers from modules.

alternatives.title: Default export
tradeoffs: May conflict with the project’s existing module convention or future additional exports.

self_critique.weakest_point: The specification cannot verify the project’s module convention from the file list alone.
self_critique.cut_or_change: Inspect the existing package and source conventions before choosing the export form, while still limiting edits to the two requested files.
